name: Rime
author: Erin Carter
description: A cluster of frosted ice spheres drifting in cold light — raymarched 3D ice that refracts the environment and glows from within with a soft subsurface luminance, brightest at the thin back-lit edges, finished with crisp glints. Crystalline and cold where Frost is milky.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: How fast the ice spheres drift; 0 holds the cluster still.

params.label: Inner glow
params.effect: Strength of the light glowing through the ice; 0 leaves it opaque, high makes it luminous.

params.label: Frost
params.effect: Surface roughness — from clear ice at 0 to a milky scattering frost at 1.

params.label: Spread
params.effect: How far the spheres roam apart; low packs a tight cluster, high scatters them.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer parallaxes the camera; 0 ignores the mouse.
